hedge_exemplars.value: Symmetric partitioning around the arithmetic mean. Because the three integers are consecutive even integers, their common difference is 2. Choosing the middle integer as the unknown n makes the sum 3n. The mean n = 138/3 = 46 is even, satisfying the parity constraint. The largest is n+2 = 48.
